description: Reference history plus 2024-02-05 with low 157.0 (below DL 157.92) but close 170.0 (above DL), then a calm day.
explanation: R4: a wick or temporary breach alone is not invalidation; only a completed close beyond DL is (D24). So the overlay status must be TESTED, not INVALIDATED. A wick below DL necessarily passes through PL, which is a test (RB 683-697), so under D3 the zone is still no entry: the scenario pins the distinction between the two exclusion reasons, not a candidate.
title: A wick below DL without a close below it: TESTED, not INVALIDATED
